sources.title: Removable and Irreducible: A Token-Cost Ledger for the Multilingual Tokenization Tax
sources.snippet: Large language models pay a well-documented tax on non-English text: the same content costs several times more tokens, and because attention is quadratic in sequence length, far more compute. We ask how much of this tax is removable. sources.title: Position: LLM Inference Should Be Evaluated as Energy-to-Token Production
sources.snippet: LLM inference is still evaluated mainly as a model or software problem: accuracy, latency, throughput, and hardware utilization. This is incomplete. At deployment scale, the relevant output is a quality-conditioned token produced under joint constraints from effective compute, delivered data-center power, cooling capacity, PUE, and utilization.
